The scheduler package (`internal/scheduler`) is only referenced within its own test/doc files — it's not wired into `server/` anywhere in the codebase.

r03. Premise correction: there is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled anywhere in this codebase. The only cron scheduler present is the generic `internal/scheduler` package (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`), which is a standalone, GitHub-Actions-inspired cron library — its "daily-cleanup" example (`Schedule: "0 2 * * *"`, i.e. 2 AM) appears only in documentation and tests (`internal/scheduler/README.md:34-35`, `internal/scheduler/doc.go:14-16`), not as an actual registered job. A search for `scheduler.` usage across `server/**/*.go` (126 files) found zero matches, and `internal/scheduler` is imported nowhere outside its own package (`example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`). No database-cleanup job (or any job) is actually registered/run in this repository — the "2 AM daily cleanup" is sample/README code, not a live schedule.
